visaFree.explainerBody: No application, no paperwork, no waiting. You simply present your passport at the border and an immigration officer reviews and stamps you in on arrival.

documents: A completed ETA application, submitted online before you travel
Proof of onward or return travel
etaRequired.explainerBody: An ETA isn't a full visa — it's a short online form you complete before you fly, usually approved within minutes and linked electronically to your passport. You still apply before you travel, just not through a consulate.
